annotations.title: List posts submitted to creator campaigns

description: Use this when the user asks which creator posts are waiting for review, or how submitted posts are doing. Submitted posts with their platform-reported views, authenticity score (0-100, with the reasons points were taken off), flags (no_disclosure, missing_hashtag, missing_mention, views_hidden, low_authenticity), status and what each has earned. Filter by campaign and status (pending_review to see what needs a decision).
name: list_campaign_posts
